queryLines:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT usage_date, SUM(net_list_cost) AS usd
  FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_dollarized_by_sku_day t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))
  WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
  GROUP BY 1
),
m AS (
  SELECT usage_date, usd,
         percentile(usd, 0.5) OVER (ORDER BY usage_date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS med,
         count(*) OVER (ORDER BY usage_date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS n
  FROM d
),
spikes AS (SELECT * FROM m WHERE n >= 5 AND med > 0 AND usd >= med * 1.15)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM spikes) AS value,
       COALESCE((SELECT concat('Worst: ', date_format(usage_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), ', ',
                 CAST(ROUND(usd * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS STRING), ' vs usual ', CAST(ROUND(med * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS STRING))
                 FROM spikes ORDER BY usd / med DESC LIMIT 1), 'No spike this window') AS target

WITH q AS (
WITH base AS (
  SELECT usage_date, CASE billing_origin_product
           WHEN 'DBSQL' THEN 'Databricks SQL' WHEN 'SQL' THEN 'SQL' WHEN 'DLT' THEN 'DLT'
           WHEN 'INTERACTIVE' THEN 'Serverless notebooks' WHEN 'ALL_PURPOSE' THEN 'All-purpose clusters'
           WHEN 'JOBS' THEN 'Jobs' WHEN 'MODEL_SERVING' THEN 'Model serving'
           ELSE COALESCE(initcap(replace(billing_origin_product, '_', ' ')), '(unlabeled product)')
         END AS product, net_list_cost
  FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_dollarized_by_sku_day t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))
  WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
)
SELECT usage_date AS day, product, ROUND(SUM(net_list_cost) * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS usd
FROM base
GROUP BY usage_date, product
),
r AS (SELECT `product` AS s, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(`usd`) DESC) AS rk FROM q WHERE `product` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `product`),
n AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM r)
SELECT q.`day`, q.`usd`,
       CASE WHEN q.`product` IS NULL OR r.rk < 8 OR n.n <= 8 THEN CAST(q.`product` AS STRING) ELSE 'Other' END AS `product`
FROM q LEFT JOIN r ON r.s = q.`product` CROSS JOIN n

datasets.name: d9b04f99
queryLines:
SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'cost_daily_spikes', 'Spend spikes', 'Trend'),
       (1, 'cost_period_over_period', 'Change vs previous period', 'Trend'),
       (2, 'cost_by_hour_of_day', 'Spend concentrated by hour of day', 'Trend'),
       (3, 'cost_dollarized_by_sku_day', 'Daily spend by SKU', 'Trend'),
       (4, 'cost_monthly_actuals', 'Spend by calendar month', 'Trend'),
       (5, 'cost_totals_by_sku_day', 'Spend by product, raw rows', 'Trend'),
       (6, 'cost_workspace_names', 'Workspace names', 'Trend')) AS c(ord, query_id, title, page)
LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 1 WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.ord

SELECT
  COALESCE(concat(n_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS `workspace_shown`,
  t.`status` AS `status`,

  SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id, sku_name, usd_last_3m_avg, usd_prior_3m_avg, status
  FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_sku_trend_12m t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))
  WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')) AND status IN ('CRITICAL', 'WARN')
),
agg AS (
  SELECT sku_name,
         SUM(usd_last_3m_avg) AS last3m,
         SUM(usd_prior_3m_avg) AS prior3m,
         MIN(CASE status WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'WARN' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) AS sev_rank

)

       ROUND(last3m * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS last_3m_usd,
       ROUND(prior3m * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS prior_3m_usd
FROM agg

LIMIT 30

       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
